breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2, where K directly enters the formula through the effective length KL. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt — which stated to treat K as affecting only the mode shape and to evaluate the Euler load from π^2 E I / L^2 — was completely omitted. The generated specification aligns with the ground truth by properly incorporating K into the buckling load calculation.
